seoTitle: Set Up Combined Postage on eBay
metaDescription: Learn how to combine postage on eBay and create flat-rate or promotional shipping rules for buyers purchasing multiple items.
intro: Combined postage lets eBay sellers offer discounted or flat-rate shipping when buyers purchase more than one item, which can encourage larger orders. This guide covers accessing shipping preferences, enabling combined payments, and setting up promotional shipping rules.

steps.heading: Access shipping preferences
steps.body: Open your eBay seller shipping settings, where combined postage and rule options are managed.

steps.heading: Enable combined payments
steps.body: Turn on combined payments so buyers purchasing multiple items can check out together.

steps.heading: Create a discounted shipping rule
steps.body: Set up a rule that automatically applies discounted or flat postage when a buyer purchases more than one item.

steps.heading: Add promotional shipping offers
steps.body: Create promotional shipping offers to encourage multi-item purchases and boost overall sales.

steps.heading: Apply to domestic and international orders
steps.body: Combined postage rules can be configured for both domestic and international shipping.

steps.heading: Manage shipping profiles and exclusions
steps.body: Review your shipping profiles and set any necessary exclusions so combined postage works smoothly with your listings.

faq.question: What is combined postage on eBay?
faq.answer: It's a shipping rule that offers discounted or flat-rate postage when a buyer purchases more than one item from you.

faq.question: Does combined postage work for international shipping?
faq.answer: Yes, you can set up combined postage rules for both domestic and international orders.

faq.question: How do I create a flat shipping rate?
faq.answer: You can configure a flat-rate shipping rule within your eBay shipping preferences, applied automatically at checkout.

faq.question: Can I exclude certain items from combined postage?
faq.answer: Yes, you can set exclusions in your shipping profiles so combined postage only applies where intended.

faq.question: Does combined postage help increase sales?
faq.answer: Yes, offering discounted or promotional shipping on multiple items can encourage buyers to purchase more at once.
